motivation.precedent: Notebook 60 found that the unchanged Notebook 36 selected long leg beat same-sector equal weight by 3.662 bps per session after the frozen two-test correction
motivation.timing: post-result mechanism diagnostic on an opened historical window
motivation.question: Does the selected-long advantage over its matched sector basket accrue intraday or overnight inside the unchanged open-to-open interval?

candidate_and_control.selected_long: positive Notebook 36 Gemma-timed and FinBERT-ranked target weights, unchanged
candidate_and_control.same_sector_control: Notebook 60 control preserving each session's selected long exposure in every sector and distributing it equally across that sector's three original members
candidate_and_control.return_horizon: same one-session open-to-open interval as Notebooks 36 and 60
candidate_and_control.price_convention: split-adjusted price returns; dividends not back-adjusted

decomposition.intraday_component: selected-long minus same-sector-control target weights times entry-session close divided by entry open minus one
decomposition.overnight_component: selected-long minus same-sector-control target weights times following open minus entry-session close divided by entry open
decomposition.identity: intraday difference plus overnight difference equals Notebook 60 selected-long minus same-sector open-to-open gross difference
decomposition.cost_treatment: gross accounting contributions only; no cost is assigned and no control ledger is constructed

estimands: mean intraday selected-long minus same-sector-control gross contribution per complete session
mean overnight selected-long minus same-sector-control gross contribution per complete session
inference.method: two-sided paired circular moving-block bootstrap versus zero
inference.positive_gate: component difference mean is positive and BH-adjusted null is rejected

mechanism_classification.intraday_only: only the intraday positive gate passes
mechanism_classification.overnight_only: only the overnight positive gate passes
